mapper.select: select id, user_id, folder_name, description, cover_url, is_public, video_count, create_time, update_time, is_deleted from collection_folder where user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = #{isDeleted} order by create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into collection_folder(user_id, folder_name, description, cover_url, is_public, video_count, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) values (#{userId}, #{folderName}, #{description}, #{coverUrl}, #{isPublic}, #{videoCount}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDeleted})
mapper.update:
update collection_folder
folder_name = #{folderName},
description = #{description},
cover_url = #{coverUrl},
is_public = #{isPublic},
video_count = #{videoCount},
update_time = #{updateTime},
is_deleted = #{isDeleted},
where id = #{id}
update collection_folder set is_deleted = 1 where id = #{id}
